details:
* Remove the certificates dropped from the bundle from the Java keystore
     after each certificate update: the removal events never reached
     ca-certificates-java, so roots such as "emSign ECC Root CA - G3"
     stayed trusted by Java in /etc/ssl/certs/java/cacerts. Only "debian:"
     aliases that no longer exist in /etc/ssl/certs are removed. No change
     to the certificates.
